topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the core learning outcomes concerning the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and proliferative mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how oncogenic mutations in key signaling cascades, such as Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinase pathways, drive cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in hematopoietic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells disrupt normal terminal differentiation in both leukemias and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Apoptosis resistance, replicative immortality, and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tumors overcome cell-autonomous barriers to survival through apoptotic resistance, telomere maintenance, and evasion of p53-mediated stress responses.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and metabolic rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the metabolic adaptations of cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis, global metabolic rewiring, and Krebs cycle mutations generating oncometabolites.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the mechanisms and timing of blood vessel recruitment necessary to support expanding tumors.

topics.label: Mechanisms and dynamics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate the multistep metastatic cascade, including tumor cell dissemination, liquid biopsy monitoring, the seed and soil hypothesis, and genomic alterations in secondary tumors.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding review and final framing remarks to close the lecture.
